identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of the Combination of Ibrutinib Plus Venetoclax Versus Chlorambucil Plus Obinutuzumab for the First-line Treatment of Participants With Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL)/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma (SLL)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Open-label, Phase 3 Study of the Combination of Ibrutinib Plus Venetoclax Versus Chlorambucil Plus Obinutuzumab for the First-line Treatment of Subjects With Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL)/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma (SLL).

armGroups.label: Treatment Arm A: Ibrutinib and Venetoclax (I+VEN)
armGroups.description: Participants will initially receive ibrutinib (420 mg \[milligrams\]/day) for 3 cycles. Venetoclax dose ramp up (from 20 to 400 mg over 5 weeks) will begin at Cycle 4 and the combination of ibrutinib and venetoclax will be given for 12 cycles (each cycle is equivalent to 28 days). Participants who subsequently develop progressive disease may enter to Subsequent Therapy Phase to receive single-agent ibrutinib until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

armGroups.label: Treatment Arm B: Chlorambucil and Obinutuzumab (G-Clb)
armGroups.description: Participants will receive chlorambucil and obinutuzumab (G-Clb) for 6 cycles. Participants will receive obinutuzumab, 1000 mg intravenously (IV) on Days 1, 8 and 15 of Cycle 1, and on Day 1 of Cycles 2 to 6 and chlorambucil 0.5 milligrams per kilogram (mg/kg) body weight, on Days 1 and 15 of Cycles 1 to 6. Participants who subsequently develop progressive disease may enter to Subsequent Therapy Phase to receive single-agent ibrutinib until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

interventions.name: Ibrutinib
interventions.description: Participants will receive ibrutinib 420 mg orally once daily up to 15 cycles.
armGroupLabels: Treatment Arm A: Ibrutinib and Venetoclax (I+VEN)

interventions.name: Venetoclax
interventions.description: Participants will receive venetoclax in combination with ibrutinib for a total of 12 cycles, beginning at Cycle 4. For the first 5 weeks of venetoclax treatment, the treatment dose will be ramped up from 20 to 400 mg.
armGroupLabels: Treatment Arm A: Ibrutinib and Venetoclax (I+VEN)

interventions.name: Chlorambucil
interventions.description: Participants will receive chlorambucil at a dose of 0.5 mg/kg body weight on Days 1 and 15 of Cycles 1 to 6.
armGroupLabels: Treatment Arm B: Chlorambucil and Obinutuzumab (G-Clb)

interventions.name: Obinutuzumab
interventions.description: Participant will receive obinutuzumab 1000 mg intravenously on Days 1, 8, and 15 of Cycle 1, and Day 1 of Cycles 2 to 6.
armGroupLabels: Treatment Arm B: Chlorambucil and Obinutuzumab (G-Clb)

interventions.name: Ibrutinib (as Subsequent Therapy)
interventions.description: Participants will receive ibrutinib 420 mg orally once daily until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity during the subsequent therapy phase.
armGroupLabels: Treatment Arm A: Ibrutinib and Venetoclax (I+VEN)
